Liquid Glass

Background image

The glass refracts whatever sits behind it. Swap in your own photo to test the effect against it.

You can also drag an image onto the canvas, or paste one with Ctrl+V.

Paste a shape from Figma

In Figma: right-click your vector → Copy as SVG, then paste it here. The glass takes that outline.

Pasting into the box applies it right away.

Save or load settings

Copy puts every slider value on your clipboard as text — keep it in a note to come back to this look later. Paste that text here and hit Load to restore it.

Pick a shape below and drag on the image to draw it — the glass effect is applied when you let go.

Inspector

Object

The shape the glass is cut from, and where it sits on the image.

Drag the shape to move it, drag a handle to resize. Hold Shift to keep the ratio; arrow keys nudge.

Glass

The same seven controls Figma's glass effect gives you.

Solver internals

Advanced — the calibration constants Figma keeps hidden. These decide how closely the render matches Figma, so try them before giving up on the Glass sliders above.
